ChargeNet and Maxem Partner to Unlock More EV Truck Charging Capacity
Published: Jun 30, 2026
ChargeNet and Maxem partner to help transport companies share EV truck charging capacity, cut costs, and speed up fleet electrification.
Read more

May 28, 2026

All Den Hartog`s Zero-Emission e-truck charging locations is now part of the ChargeNet network. Higher utilization and extra revenue.
Read more

May 19, 2026

Read more

Feb 4, 2026
ChargeNet and Equans E-Mobility: Getting More Out of Charging Sites Together
ChargeNet partners with Equans E-Mobility to help owners of Equans-built charging sites open them up selectively, boost utilization, and earn extra revenue.
Read more

Read more

Sept 1, 2025
ChargeNet expands their use cases with the help of the Growth Accelerator Demonstration Energy Voucher
The Energy Demonstration Growth Accelerator was awarded to ChargeNet in May. A look back at the opportunities this grant has offered us.
Read more

Electric Trucks are Gaining Momentum, ING research sees Tipping Point Ahead
